d: Apple’s first foldable iPhone is facing early durability concerns, with some owners reporting cracks, bright lines and unusual sounds from the inner display just days after purchase. In this video, Firstpost examines the problems affecting the iPhone Duo, which starts at $1,999, and Apple’s response that a small number of devices have screen issues and can be replaced through AppleCare. The video looks at repair experts’ theories about a possible hinge-related pressure point, Samsung’s mocking response to its rival’s foldable debut, and the irony of Samsung’s own early Galaxy Fold…
